name: council
description: Multi-perspective council for one open decision, including architecture selection when a draft exists and the goal is to choose rather than edit. It records four named first positions before synthesis and compares challengers under a neutral brief; missing isolation lowers assurance instead of blocking the debate. Capable hosts may reach CONVERGED; weaker hosts return unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY. Use review-loop to fix artifacts to APPROVE. Requires ~/.agency-agents.

interface.shortDescription: Draft-aware CONVERGED or non-authorizing ADVISORY council.
interface.longDescription: Seat one agency-agents specialist persona per named viewpoint gap and record first positions before synthesis. For an existing architecture draft, adopt a neutral brief, search challengers with the strongest available separation, and compare the draft without editing it. Missing isolation lowers assurance rather than blocking the debate; canonical records enable audited CONVERGED, while weaker hosts produce unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to weigh this decision from several expert perspectives.
